class_id: SME document discovery asks only one exchange although the spec's stated order names two
feature: scraper/src/services/document-discovery-runner.ts -- the SME leg of exchange document discovery
symptom: for an SME IPO the discovery code path calls NSE and never calls BSE, although the spec states the SME exchange order as NSE then BSE. A BSE-only-listed SME IPO therefore has no exchange document source consulted at all: NSE correctly abstains (or, per F-188, was misread as an answer), and BSE is simply never asked, so the chain has zero real coverage rather than one abstention and one answer.
first_seen: 2026-09-26 -- #1201, found while reading the #632 cause data on ipodhan_staging (read-only). Of the 44 SME IPOs whose BLOCKED_ALL rows were settled or failed by NSE alone, 29 return an empty NSE `issueInfo: {}` when checked live (e.g. PESHWA, ROBOKIDZ), meaning those 29 are BSE-only listings for which BSE document discovery was never attempted.
fix_prs: #1201 (fix/1201-sme-docs-ask-bse): the SME path asks BSE second (NSE first), skipped only when listing_exchanges is known to exclude BSE; unit tests on the real runner with live BSE SME captures (scraper/tests/unit/services/document-discovery-sme-bse.test.ts). Residual: a CLOSED BSE-only SME issue needs a remembered ipos.bse_ipo_no (NULL for all 53 staging cases), so it stays unreachable until that is populated.
detection_check: none yet. A useful check: for every SME IPO with a BLOCKED_ALL or EXCHANGES:failed chain, assert at least one BSE call was attempted before concluding the chain; today no check asserts BSE was ever consulted for an SME row.
